snippet.description:
C.B. Macpherson is one of the most important thinkers for understanding the criticism of liberal democracy, capitalism, equality and power in Political Theory.

In this lecture, we discuss Macpherson’s idea of democracy and why he believed that political equality alone cannot make a society truly democratic.

The session covers:

* Macpherson as a Critical Liberal / Liberal Socialist
* Protective and Developmental Democracy
* Elitist and Pluralist Models of Democracy
* Macpherson’s critique of Schumpeter and Robert Dahl
* Procedural vs Substantive Democracy
* Extractive Power vs Developmental Power
* Critique of Capitalist Liberal Democracy
* Why Social & Economic Equality Matter
* The Real World of Democracy
* Can non-Western and Communist systems also be democratic?
* Major criticisms of Macpherson

An important lecture for UPSC PSIR students, especially for questions on Democracy, Equality, Power and Liberal Political Theory.
